speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To understand the cause, can you tell me how long you have been feeling these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that history. Given your age, risk factors, and symptoms, I am concerned about Hepatitis C or a related liver condition. Have you ever been tested for Hepatitis B or C before?

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Serology_Panel (HCV, HBV)
REQUEST TEST: HIV_Antibody_Antigen
REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests (specifically Alkaline_Phosphatase and Bilirubin)

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Hepatitis C Serology: Not Reported; Hepatitis B Serology: Not Reported; HIV Antibody/Antigen: Not Reported; Liver Function Tests: Alkaline Phosphatase 460 U/L, Bilirubin Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin Direct 0.9 mg/dL.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hepatitis C Serology: Not Reported; Hepatitis B Serology: Not Reported; HIV Antibody/Antigen: Not Reported; Liver Function Tests: Alkaline Phosphatase 460 U/L, Bilirubin Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin Direct 0.9 mg/dL.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The results confirm significant cholestasis with a markedly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase (460 U/L) and mild jaundice, while Hepatitis B, C, and HIV serologies were not reported. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and sexually active status with multiple partners, do you have any family members or close contacts with liver disease, or have you ever received blood transfusions?

REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Panels (ANA, ASMA, AMA)
REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_of_Liver

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Autoimmune Panels: Anti-Nuclear Antibody: Negative, Antimitochondrial Antibodies: Negative; Ultrasound of Liver: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound showing thickening and focal dilatation of the bile ducts, combined with your history of Ulcerative Colitis, strongly suggests Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. Do you currently have any visible bumps or skin tags anywhere on your body? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTB

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis

The combination of your history of ulcerative colitis, the ultrasound findings of bile duct thickening and dilation, and your symptoms of severe pruritus and scleral icterus is diagnostic for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. The negative autoimmune panels help rule out other causes like Primary Biliary Cholangitis.
